claims.quote: NMDA receptors that contain the GluN2B subunit have unique pharmacological properties, being inhibited by multiple structurally distinct series of biaryl compounds with high potency and selectivity.
radiprodil inhibits NMDA receptors that contain GluN2B with high potency and selectivity and appears to be safe in humans.
radiprodil is an effective antagonist at >80% of human disease-associated GRIN1 and GRIN2B missense variants tested in vitro (22/27, equally or more effective as wild-type receptors)
including variants in the pore-forming region, linker regions and elsewhere that uniformly increase NMDA receptor-mediated charge transfer.

claims.object_text: knock-in mouse line harbouring the gain-of-function variant GluN2B-Ser810Arg
claims.quote: a knock-in mouse line harbouring the gain-of-function variant GluN2B-Ser810Arg
radiprodil blocks synaptic GluN2B receptors in brain slices acutely isolated from a knock-in mouse line harbouring the gain-of-function variant GluN2B-Ser810Arg
radiprodil delays the onset of seizures (458 ± 90 s, versus 207 ± 23 s in the vehicle group) in response to in vivo administration of the chemoconvulsant pentylenetetrazole.

These data support the potential utility of GluN2B-selective antagonists, such as radiprodil, for clinical treatments of neurological conditions where clinical aetiologies might involve increased current mediated by GluN2B-containing NMDA receptors.
